"""Use existing qualified Python dependencies; preserve the earlier failed receipt."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013')
L = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase_server_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    prior_path = B / 'main-phase-cache-host-check-root-v1/record.json'
    prior = json.loads(prior_path.read_text())
    assert not prior['active'] and not prior['passed']
    assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] for c in prior['commands'])
    assert prior['commands'][-1]['label'] == 'server-suite' and prior['commands'][-1]['exit_code'] == 1
    assert 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named' in prior['evidence']['server-suite']['stderr']
    assert all(c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in prior['commands'][:-1])
    out = B / 'main-phase-cache-server-check-root-v2'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, main_reviewed=True, commands=[], evidence={},
        gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, production_admitted=False,
        original_failed_receipt=dict(path=str(prior_path), sha256=m.sha(prior_path)),
        correction='Existing dependency-complete venv; no source/fixture weakening or new package installation',
        source_pins=prior['source_pins'])

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    env = dict(PATH=str(L / 'venv/bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8',
        LC_ALL='C.UTF-8', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
    try:
        for name, digest in r['source_pins'].items():
            assert m.sha(W / name) == digest
        for label, suite in [('phase-lifetime', 'serve.test_server.PhaseExperimentLifetime'), ('server-suite', 'serve.test_server')]:
            c, so, se = owner.run(label, [str(L / 'venv/bin/python'), '-m', 'unittest', suite, '-v'],
                env, W, wall=180, cpu=1200, rss_cap=2 << 30, text_cap=2 << 20, total_cap=16 << 20)
            r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
            save()
            assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label
        assert m.sha(prior_path) == r['original_failed_receipt']['sha256']
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True)
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'error')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
